MESSAGE:
Subject: Acme Pricing Review – Competitiveness Analysis at Proposed Increases

To the CFO,

Per your request, here is a comparison of Acme's pricing against the two competitor quotes we have on file, at the current rate, +7%, and +12%.

Pricing Comparison (Rs per month):

| Pricing Level | Acme | Zenith Cloud | Orbit Hosting | Competitiveness |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Current | 2,00,000 | 2,10,804 | 2,15,595 | Most competitive – lowest of the three |
| +7% | 2,14,000 | 2,10,804 | 2,15,595 | Still competitive – below Orbit, above Zenith |
| +12% | 2,24,000 | 2,10,804 | 2,15,595 | Not competitive – highest of the three |

Recommendation:
At its current price, Acme is the most competitive vendor. A 7% increase (Rs 2,14,000/month) would keep Acme broadly competitive, staying below Orbit Hosting's quote, though slightly above Zenith Cloud's. A 12% increase (Rs 2,24,000/month) would make Acme the most expensive of the three options and would erode our pricing advantage.

We recommend countering Acme's proposal by capping any increase at 7%, which preserves competitiveness against both quoted alternatives. We would not advise accepting the full 12% increase given the available market comparisons.

Regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement
